$description: Design system v2 token proposal (W3C design-tokens-like). Default $value is the light mode; $extensions.scribe.modes gives light, dark, lightHC (Increase Contrast, light) and darkHC. $extensions.scribe.current maps to today's packages/design-tokens/src/tokens.ts name (null or 'new' = no current token). Rationale and contrast method: docs/design/system/FOUNDATIONS.md. Proposal only: tokens.ts stays the source of truth until rows DS2-01 to DS2-06 land.

mergeDistance.$description: GlassContainer spacing; equals layout.controlGap. Tune on device.

solid.$description: Fallback for every glass surface: Reduce Transparency, iOS below 26, Android, web. Same shape and size as the glass it replaces.

regular.$description: Content layer standard material. Use: panel over mixed content, never over a face or a letter's words. Secondary text on it uses glassLabelSecondary.

thick.$description: Content layer standard material. Use: fine text over a busy picture. Secondary text on it uses glassLabelSecondary.
